name: A Threat Within
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
I hope you strapped your belt on tight, young champion, because there is work to do here in Northshire.

And I don't mean farming.

The Stormwind guards are hard pressed to keep the peace here, with so many of us in distant lands and so many threats pressing close.  And so we're enlisting the aid of anyone willing to defend their home.  And their alliance.

If you're here to answer the call, then speak with my superior, Marshal McBride.  He's inside the abbey behind me.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah, good.  Another volunteer.  We're getting a lot of you these days.

I hope it's enough.

The human lands are threatened from without, and so many of our forces have been marshaled abroad.  This, in turn, leaves room for corrupt and lawless groups to thrive within our borders.

It is a many-fronted battle we wage, adventurer.  Gird yourself for a long campaign.

chain.subtitle: 18 quests from level 1 to 5, 2,710 XP in all.

quests.name: Kobold Camp Cleanup
quests.objectiveText: Kill 10 Kobold Vermin, then return to Marshal McBride.

quests.name: Brotherhood of Thieves
quests.objectiveText: Bring 12 Red Burlap Bandanas to Deputy Willem outside the Northshire Abbey.

quests.name: One quest for each class
quests.objectiveText: Warrior, Paladin, Rogue, Priest, Mage, Warlock

quests.name: Wolves Across the Border
quests.objectiveText: Bring 8 pieces of Tough Wolf Meat to Eagan Peltskinner outside Northshire Abbey.

quests.name: Investigate Echo Ridge
quests.objectiveText: Kill 10 Kobold Workers, then report back to Marshal McBride.

quests.name: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot
quests.objectiveText: Kill Garrick Padfoot and bring his head to Deputy Willem at Northshire Abbey.

quests.name: Skirmish at Echo Ridge
quests.objectiveText: Kill 12 Kobold Laborers, then return to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey.

quests.name: Milly's Harvest
quests.objectiveText: Bring 8 crates of Milly's Harvest to Milly Osworth at Northshire Abbey.

quests.name: Report to Goldshire
quests.objectiveText: Take Marshal McBride's Documents to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.

quests.name: Grape Manifest
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Grape Manifest to Brother Neals in Northshire Abbey.
